patterns.note: Prominent use of full-width, immersive hero sections with text overlays and clear calls-to-action.
Extensive use of responsive grid layouts for product and category displays, often with 2-4 columns, maintaining visual consistency across different content types.
Horizontal scrolling sections are used for curated content collections, allowing users to browse related items without navigating away.
Section headings are large, bold, sans-serif, and frequently in all caps, creating strong visual breaks and clear content hierarchy.
A high-contrast brand palette of black, white, and red is consistently applied, with a vibrant green reserved exclusively for primary call-to-action buttons.
No scroll-triggered motion or animations are observed; the design relies on static hierarchy and clear content blocks for visual organization.
Lifestyle imagery is integrated into full-width sections to showcase products in context, effectively breaking up product grids and adding an editorial feel.

technique_notes: The site employs a clean, modular layout with distinct content blocks, often using full-bleed, high-resolution imagery for visual impact, especially in hero and lifestyle sections.
Call-to-action buttons consistently use a high-contrast green fill against white or dark backgrounds, ensuring maximum visibility and guiding user interaction.
Typography utilizes a strong, sans-serif font family for both headings and body text, with headings often in uppercase and bold for emphasis, while body text maintains high readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, often uppercase labels for categories, creating a clear and impactful hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons and image cards have very slight rounding, almost sharp edges).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced (sections have generous vertical padding, but content within grid layouts is relatively tight).

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its powerful use of high-quality, full-bleed product and lifestyle photography that creates an immersive brand experience. It effectively balances a clean, grid-based layout with dynamic visual storytelling, making the product discovery process feel editorial and engaging rather than purely transactional.
